title: SKE Crystal 2400 4in1 White Edition Pre-Filled Vape Pods 20mg - 4 x Pods
description: Dive into a medley of fruity delights with the SKE Crystal 2400 4 in 1 White Edition Multi-Flavour replacement pods, now at Vapestore. This assortment includes Watermelon Ice, Pink Lemonade, Watermelon Strawberry, and Melon Berry, each offering a distinct and refreshing vaping experience. The Nic-Salt infused pods deliver both exquisite flavours and satisfying nicotine hits, ideal for MTL vaping enthusiasts. These replacement pods seamlessly fit into the SKE Crystal 4in1 Rechargeable Pod Kit, featuring an easy-to-use rotating mechanism for flavour variety in every vape session.
